correctness.rationale: Cyclicizer {1,a^n} are two universal vertices. Remaining rotations form K_{2n-2}, while each inverse pair of outside elements forms one K2, no cross-adjacencies, giving n+2 true-twin clique classes. At most one initially white vertex per class is necessary. Any such white profile except all n+2 classes occupied is forceable: if universal class blue, blue mates force peripheral whites; otherwise an entirely-blue peripheral clique forces universal white, then all remaining whites. One white in every class stalls. Multiply per-class factors u^w+w u^(w-1) and subtract the single stalled white profile to get displayed polynomial. Its first nonzero coefficient is 2^(n+1)n^2 at u^(3n-1). A Gram pattern using e0 for rotations, e_i for outside pairs, and h=sum_i e_i for universal pair yields rank n+1 and exact off-diagonal graph; M<=Z gives rank>=4n-(3n-1)=n+1. Independent exact enumeration all subsets of Q8,Q12,Q16 graph based on directly reconstructed group multiplication gave Z=5,8,11 and minimum counts 32,144,512; symbolic proof covers every n.
